mainEntity.name: I'm a complete beginner — which course should I start with?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Beginners Camera Course is the natural starting point: three weekly evening classes that take you off Auto and teach exposure, focus and composition. Many students then add the Lightroom Editing Course for a complete foundation. If you'd like help choosing, book a free consultation and I'll point you the right way.

mainEntity.name: How much does a photography course cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Group courses in Coventry start at £150 for a three-week evening class (beginners camera or Lightroom editing). Private 1-2-1 lessons are from £65/hr in person and from £50/hr online (less in bundles), and monthly mentoring starts from £20/mo. There's also a free 60-module online course if you'd like to start at no cost. Each course page shows its exact price.

mainEntity.name: Are there any free photography courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The free 60-module online photography course covers camera settings, composition, gear and practical assignments — self-paced, with no obligation. It's a good place to build the basics before deciding on a paid group course, private lessons or mentoring.

mainEntity.name: Are your courses in person, online, or both?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. The group courses (beginners camera, photo editing, portrait, projects) run in person in Coventry. Private 1-2-1 lessons, monthly mentoring and RPS distinction support are available in person or online via Zoom — so you can learn whichever way suits you.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an expensive camera or lenses to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Any DSLR, mirrorless or bridge camera is fine to learn on — you don't need expensive lenses or kit. The courses are about understanding and using what you already have. Bring your camera and we'll work with it.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between group courses, 1-2-1 lessons and mentoring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Group courses follow a set syllabus in small classes — ideal for structured learning with others. Private 1-2-1 lessons are built entirely around you and move at your pace. Monthly mentoring gives you ongoing assignments and feedback over time. Many students combine them.

mainEntity.name: Is a photography course difficult for beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The beginners courses assume no prior knowledge, the groups are small (typically four or fewer), and questions are always welcomed. Everyone starts somewhere — the whole point is to build your confidence step by step in a supportive setting.

mainEntity.name: How do I book, and can I get help choosing?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can see upcoming dates on the course finder, or click any course above for full details and booking. If you're unsure which path is right, book a free consultation or call 0781 701 7994 and I'll recommend the best route for your goals.
